title: OpenMM native bounded MBAR free-energy estimator
bounded_subset: K-by-N reduced potentials and per-state counts; stable self-consistent/Newton solution, covariance, overlap, and effective sample numbers; no timeseries subsampling or bootstrap.
reference_pipeline: Locked OpenMM evaluates reduced potentials for bounded oscillator systems, then locked pymbar.MBAR solves the estimator.
